tasks.notes: Created WebContextMenuSheet and wired WebView.setOnLongClickListener with HitTestResult parsing to support links, images, and image-links (Open in New Tab, Open in Background, Copy Link Address, Download Image, Copy Image Address, and Share).

tasks.title: Align site dark/light mode with browser state without forcing dark mode
tasks.notes: Fixed website dark mode: switched themes.xml base to Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar, added androidx.webkit:webkit:1.12.0, configured WebSettingsCompat with DARK_STRATEGY_WEB_THEME_DARKENING_ONLY and disabled algorithmic darkening so sites supporting prefers-color-scheme match the browser theme without forced inversion.

tasks.title: Support blob: URL downloads via WebView JavaScript bridge
tasks.notes: Added BlobDownloadBridge JavascriptInterface and downloadBlob helper to convert blob: URLs via XHR and FileReader into Base64 data URLs for seamless stream download.

tasks.title: Fix duplicate downloads on retry by updating existing DownloadRecord in-place
tasks.notes: Added DownloadCoordinator.retryDownload to restart existing DownloadRecord in-place without generating duplicate download cards.

tasks.title: Restore previous webpage on Back gesture/button after tapping Home button
tasks.notes: Added previousWebUrlBeforeHome tracking in BrowserTab when navigating to home, allowing back gesture or back button to restore previous active website.
